bulk_generation.split_policy: independent randomized layouts; each role pair has 16 train / 2 validation / 2 test; no multiview or augmentation siblings
bulk_generation.distance_bin_policy: best-effort per scene; after 100 visual configurations may accept another feasible bin, explicitly recorded
bulk_generation.label_policy: shortest valid 1mm-grid displacement over original 8 directions; accept only prescribed LEFT/RIGHT label
bulk_generation.limitations: One shelf geometry with varied materials, lighting and viewpoint; 15 existing object meshes; no robot executor/dynamics/grasp validation; static conservative AABB corridor proxy
